author: Department of Hydrology and Meteorology, Nepal
description: Heavy monsoon rainfall on August 8, 2023 caused river flooding and inundation in Bhaktapur. Reported affected locations included Hanuman Ghat, Ram Mandir, Shanti Niketan School, and Siddhi Memorial Women and Children Hospital. DHM recorded 77.1 mm of rainfall at Bhaktapur and 100.4 mm at Changu Narayan on August 8. Event impacts were documented by The Kathmandu Post: https://kathmandupost.com/bhaktapur/2023/08/08/heavy-downpour-inundates-bhaktapur-settlements. Sponsor photographs remain pending access and verification.
evidenceSource: Department of Hydrology and Meteorology, Nepal; The Kathmandu Post
